InstallPrivacy

A few steps. Then read.

Lunori 0.6.1 is available as a browser extension with a macOS companion and as a local Codex plugin. Store listings are not live yet.

Before you start

You need macOS, Node.js 22 or newer, an eligible ChatGPT Plus or Pro account. Connect Lunori using Continue with ChatGPT and authorize plan usage. Translation uses your shared account limits.

Chrome or Arc

  1. Download the macOS package and extract it to a folder you will keep.
  2. After installation, open Lunori and choose Continue with ChatGPT.
  3. Open Terminal in the extracted folder and run zsh Install.command. The installer copies the companion to a permanent Application Support folder.
  4. Open chrome://extensions (or arc://extensions), enable Developer mode, choose Load unpacked, and select the extracted extension folder.
  5. Pin Lunori. On a normal web page, open its popup, choose a language, and click Translate page.

Keep the extension folder after installation. Protected browser pages and the Chrome Web Store itself cannot be translated.

Codex plugin

Download the plugin source and extract the lunori folder. In Codex, ask the built-in plugin-creator skill to install that folder into your personal marketplace. Start a new task to load its tools.

Use plugin-creator to install the extracted Lunori plugin folder
into my personal marketplace. Preserve its included MCP server and skill.

Then ask “Use Lunori to translate this paragraph into English” or “Show my available translation models.” The plugin translates supplied text; the browser extension handles pages.

The local MCP plugin is not listed in OpenAI’s public directory. Public submission currently requires a remote MCP endpoint or separate local-MCP support.

Bring back the toolbar

Use Undo immediately after hiding it. Later, press Alt+Shift+H on the same page, or open the extension popup and click Show toolbar. Alt+Shift+T translates or restores the active page.

Remove Lunori

Remove the extension in your browser, then run node host/uninstall.mjs from the download folder. This removes native-host registration and companion files while preserving ChatGPT sign-in. Remove the plugin through Codex’s plugin interface.
